title: Free information geometry and the model theory of noncommutative stochastic processes
summary: We study entropy and optimal transport theory in the free probabilistic setting motivated by the large-$n$ theory of random tuples of matrices. We define a new version of free entropy $χ_{\operatorname{chron}}^{\mathcal{U}}$, which is concave along geodesics in the corresponding Wasserstein space. Moreover, the heat evolution satisfies the evolution variational inequality, which means that the heat evolution is the Wasserstein gradient flow for entropy in the metric sense.
